title: Replace custom browser Nostr WebSocket management with nostr-tools SimplePool
observed_behavior_before: web/src/lib/nostr/client.js contained an exported NostrClient class with a sockets Map, custom reconnect timers, subscription bookkeeping, per-relay message queues, and pending publish OK tracking.
control-plane helpers inspected nostr.sockets directly to determine open relay URLs.
intended_behavior: Browser Nostr relay transport uses nostr-tools SimplePool for relay connection lifecycle, reconnection, subscription reissue, event dedupe, and publish OK handling.
The existing nostr singleton API remains available for consumers: connect, subscribe, queryUntilEose, query, publish, disconnect, getRelays, setRelays, connected, and connectionStatus.
Inbound EVENTs remain validated before application callbacks trust them.
Historical queries still complete only after EOSE from every connected relay in the query snapshot, and CLOSED/abort/timeout paths fail closed with NostrIncompleteEOSEError.
Publish results preserve per-relay accepted/rejected outcome semantics and do not assume batch atomicity.

excluded: Splitting client.js helpers/constants into separate modules; tracked by downstream bead bahia-rbqz.
Replacing queryUntilEose bootstrap with streaming application; tracked by downstream bead bahia-ef15.
